title: Phoenix Gramedia Licenses Silent Hill f Novel
content: Kadokawa and Gramedia's Phoenix Gramedia company announced on Tuesday that it has licensed Shiro Kuro 's novelization of Silent Hill f , the recent spinoff game for the Silent Hill franchise , and will release it in Indonesia "soon." The novelization originally released in Japan in October 2025.
author: ANN

title: Madoka Magica -Walpurgisnacht: Rising- Anime Film Opens in Singapore on October 31
content: Aniplus Asia announced on Tuesday that it will open Puella Magi Madoka Magica The Movie: Walpurgisnacht: Rising ( Gekijōban Mahō Shōjo Madoka Magica: Walpurgis no Kaiten ), the official sequel to the Puella Magi Madoka Magica The Movie Part 3: Rebellion film, in Singapore on October 31.
author: ANN

title: Ani-One Asia Licenses Dark Machine the Animation Series
content: Ani-One Asia announced on Tuesday that it will stream Dark Machine the Animation , the original anime for the Dark Machine game and anime project , beginning on October 14 at 2:15 a.m. GMT +8.
author: ANN

title: Attack on Titan Musical Starts World Tour in Singapore Next April
content: Attack on Titan : The Musical , the stage musical based on Hajime Isayama 's Attack on Titan manga, announced on Tuesday that the musical will go on a world tour that will begin with a run at the Sands Theatre, Marina Bay Sands in Singapore from April 15 to May 2, 2027.
author: ANN

title: Hindi Dub of My Hero Academia Anime Streams on Ani-One India YouTube Channel
content: The anime's eighth and final season debuted in October 2025. Crunchyroll streamed it in India as it aired in Japan and also streamed English and Hindi dubs. Anime Times also streamed the season in India.
author: ANN

title: Zavvi Online Store Goes Into Administration
content: "The Company has ceased trading with immediate effect. The Company is unable to fulfil any outstanding orders or pre-orders. Customers should not place any new orders through the Company's website.
author: ANN

title: MVM Announces New Acquisitions For Early 2027
content: MVM has announced on its X/Twitter feed that it will release two titles in early 2027 as Collector's Editions: the film Fate/Grand Order Final Singularity - Grand Temple of Time: Solomon (pictured right) and Is It Wrong to Try to Pick Up Girls in a Dungeon? Season 5.
author: ANN

title: Netflix India Lists Cyberpunk Edgerunners 2 Anime for Release on October 20
content: Netflix is listing the Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 anime for release in India on October 20. The staff describe the series: It presents a new standalone 10-episode story from the world of Cyberpunk 2077— a raw chronicle of redemption and revenge.
author: ANN

title: Ghibli's Arrietty Opens in UK and Ireland IMAX cinemas from Wednesday
content: GKIDS will release Studio Ghibli 's 2010 film Arrietty , directed by Hiromasa Yonebayashi , on Wednesday October 14 and 15 in IMAX cinemas in the UK and Ireland, followed by a wider cinema release from Friday October 16. Screening dates and venue details are listed at https://www.gkids.co.uk/tickets/ .
author: ANN
